name: dartix
description: Half-it dart scoring — React app, thin Node API, shared rules engine

scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start -w packages/api
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run dev:all
scripts.dev:all: (npm run dev -w packages/api & npm run dev -w packages/web & wait)
scripts.verify: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run verify:history -w packages/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/api && npm run build -w packages/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
